facts.fact: The National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) has approximately 2 million people registered in its national identity database, according to Halmeel's director general.
Halmeel's director general says Halmeel is integrating its systems with NIRA's national identity database, and the national ID is the only identification accepted at its service centers.
